input: Schedule a tai chi class at the community center

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a Tai Chi Class at the Community Center
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange and book a tai chi class at their local community center.

questions.title: Are you signing up as a student or teaching the class?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to enroll in an existing class or organize and instruct one themselves.

questions.title: Which specific community center do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify the exact community center by name or location so the right contact or booking system can be used.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred day of the week?
questions.description: Determine which day or days the user is available or prefers for the class.

questions.title: What time of day works best for you?
questions.description: Find out the preferred time slot, such as morning, afternoon, or evening.

questions.title: What is your current tai chi experience level?
questions.description: Establish whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced practitioner to match the right class.

questions.title: Is there a target start date you are working toward?
questions.description: Identify any deadline or preferred start date so the scheduling process can be prioritized accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for class fees or registration?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints so options can be filtered by cost.
